name: ScaleCrafter (conv dilation)
plain: Enlarges UNet convolution receptive fields at high resolution by dilating 3×3 convolutions inside a timestep range, with bicubic resampling of input when the rate isn't an integer. This also targets repeated subjects at larger than training size.
math:
dilation d' = ceil(rate); padding=d'; interp=d'/rate.
For module: x→ interpolate(x, interp) → conv dilated → interpolate back. Selected Conv2d kernel 3, stride 1 in blocks by depth. Applied for 1000−end ≤ t ≤ 1000−start.

props.hook: set_model_unet_function_wrapper temporarily replacing module.forward on shared Conv2d, restored after each call

label: from code
surprise: The wrapper mutates shared Conv2d modules in place; an exception in the model call would leave them dilated, as restore has no finally.
